articles.title: ‘BKU’ star Nivin Pauly talks about the success of Mamitha Baiju starrer; shares details about his villainous role in Lokesh Cinematic Universe, ‘Playing an antagonist will surprise audience’
articles.summary: Malayalam actor Nivin Pauly led Mollywood’s ‘Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’ starring alongside Mamitha Baiju, directed by Girish AD.
articles.body: Malayalam actor Nivin Pauly led Mollywood’s ‘Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’ starring alongside Mamitha Baiju, directed by Girish AD. The film became Mollywood’s highest-grossing release minting over Rs. 331 crore, surpassing the 2025 blockbuster Lokah: Chapter 1. The actor shared his take on how the film achieved such success. He also spoke about playing an antagonist in Lokesh Cinematic Universe and about other projects and shared updates about his upcoming projects.In a recent conversation with Variety India, Nivin Pauly shared that he did not expect the simple, small-town story to achieve such a major theatrical success. He said the film’s emotional connection with audiences played a key role in its performance.Nivin Pauly on Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’s Box Office success“People often assume that a film needs a huge budget, big sets, foreign locations, and a grand scale to break box-office records. This simple film has done that and I think it surprised everyone, including us. The truth is that when a film connects with people emotionally and is made with sincerity and honesty, audiences respond. They want something they can relate to—something that helps them relax and disconnect from stress for a few hours. The biggest compliment I received was that the film took away people’s stress for three hours,” he said.Nivin Pauly talks about his chemistry with Mamitha Baiju‘Bethlehem Kudumba Unit’ explores an unconventional age-gap romance between the lead characters. Nivin said his long-standing friendship with Mamitha Baiju helped them build a natural emotional connection on screen.“Mamitha and I have been good friends for years, so we already knew each other well. We used to talk about our dreams, cinema, family, scripts, and career choices. If she had doubts about a script or a film, she would call me and I would share advice from my experience. Because of that friendship, we did not approach the relationship in the film as two people separated by age. We approached it as two close friends working together, and that comfort helped the dynamic feel natural,” he explained.Nivin Pauly on joining the Lokesh Cinematic UniverseNivin Pauly is now part of the Lokesh Cinematic Universe (LCU) and will take on an antagonistic role, marking a change from the relaxed romantic characters audiences have often associated with him.“It is always good to surprise the audience. After doing two back-to-back feel-good romantic comedies, it felt like the right time to offer something different. Playing an antagonist will surprise them. The film is big in scale, with large sets and high-quality production, and I hope it does well. Although the villain is dark and cruel, he also has a touch of dark humour, which made the role exciting to explore,” he said.Nivin Pauly’s new film with Rukmini VasanthNivin is also working on his upcoming romantic comedy, ‘NP51’, which pairs him with Rukmini Vasanth for the first time.The actor said they had spent only a few days together on the sets and were still getting to know each other. The team then took an Onam break, followed by a period of mourning after the death of a colleague.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Quentin Tarantino reveals the first 17 minutes of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth at special screening ahead of November release
articles.summary: Quentin Tarantino surprises fans at AFI Fest by screening the first 17 minutes of his upcoming film, The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth, a sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. Join the excitement ahead of its November release!
articles.body: Fans have been waiting with full zeal and excitement over the release of ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,' which is an indirect sequel of ‘Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.' While the release date still has some time, Quentin Tarantino, the famed director behind the movie, managed to surprise fans by revealing the first 17 minutes of the upcoming film!Quentin Tarantino shows select fans the first 17 minutes of ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'While attending the AFI Fest on Friday night at the TCL Chinese Theatre in Hollywood, Tarantino had quite a surprise in store for fans, as he had a special screening of ‘Once Upon A Time In Hollywood.' While many thought that this was the only thing that they would be seeing, the filmmaker ended up playing out the first 17 minutes of the upcoming Brad Pitt film, leaving everyone in shock.The screening was then followed by a question and answer session with the filmmaker as well. The Wrap reported that he extensively talked about the movies, including how attached he is to the characters of the first film, which originally came out in 2019. He shared during the Q&A session: “It’s not about a story, the fact that it’s just about this folklore that’s a mix of real things that happened back then and real people and a real industry, and then also this kind of fantastical version that I created.”The 17 minutes from the film were exclusively screened for the fans that were attending the event and have not been released publicly.More about ‘The Further Misadventures of Cliff Booth’The film is a sequel to the 2019 film ‘Once Upon A Time In Hollywood'; however, this time around the storyline is central to Brad Pitt’s character as Cliff Booth. The film has also cast Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, and Peter Weller, among many others. Tarantino directed the first film, while he returned for the second movie as the screenplay writer.The movie will arrive in IMAX theaters on November 25 and later will be made available for streaming on Netflix from December 23 onwards.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Jailer 2’ box office collection Day 11 [Live]: Rajinikanth’s film nears Rs 442 crore India gross, set for Sunday hike
articles.summary: Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' continues to draw audiences to theatres as the action entertainer moves further into its second week.
articles.body: Rajinikanth’s 'Jailer 2' continues to draw audiences to theatres as the action entertainer moves further into its second week. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the sequel opened to strong numbers at the Indian box office and maintained its momentum during the first week. The film features Rajinikanth as Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, with Mohanlal, Shivarajkumar and several other actors playing key roles. After a strong start, the film’s weekday collections have shown fluctuations, while the second weekend remains important for its overall theatrical performance.Jailer 2 Review'Jailer 2' surpassed Rs 300 crore in its first weekAccording to Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' collected an estimated Rs 317.20 crore net in India during its first week. The film earned Rs 59.70 crore on Day 1, Rs 37.10 crore on Day 2, Rs 47.25 crore on Day 3 and Rs 55.85 crore on Day 4. It went on to collect Rs 42.35 crore on Day 5, Rs 46.80 crore on Day 6 and Rs 28.15 crore on Day 7. In the second week, the film earned Rs 17.15 crore on Day 8, Rs 14.50 crore on Day 9 and Rs 24.15 crore on Day 10.‘Jailer 2’ opens strong on Day 11 According to live box-office estimates by Sacnilk, 'Jailer 2' has collected Rs 9.20 crore net in India on Day 11, Sunday, October 25, taking its total domestic net collection to Rs 382.20 crore and gross collection to Rs 447.66 crore. The film is currently running across 5,596 shows in Tamil, Telugu and Hindi. The Tamil version leads the day's earnings with Rs 6.84 crore from 2,729 shows, followed by the Telugu version with Rs 1.46 crore from 883 shows and the Hindi version with Rs 0.90 crore from 1,984 shows. articles.title: Meghan Markle sent letter to her estranged father after his amputation; she informed him that she was aware of the child sexual abuse allegation
articles.summary: Meghan Markle's last letter to her father, Thomas Markle Sr., reveals her awareness of child sexual abuse allegations against him. The letter was sent after his leg amputation, severing their ties completely and emphasizing her commitment to protect her children.
articles.body: Trigger warning: This article contains mentions of child sexual abuseThe last time that Meghan Markle contacted her estranged father, Thomas Markle Sr. was through a final letter, in which the ‘Suits’ alum told him that she was well aware of all of the child sexual abuse allegations against him. According to recent reports, this letter was sent to Thomas last year after his leg had to be amputated due to a severe blood clot.Meghan Markle’s last letter to her estranged fatherThe Sun recently reported that Markle sent a final letter to her father after his leg amputation in the Philippines. The content of the letters included her mentioning that she is cutting all ties from him, telling him that she was well aware of all of the allegations that were being investigated against him, and that she would never allow him to meet her two children.The outlet also revealed that the Duchess of Sussex made the hospital staff deliver her final letter to him at his bedside, make him sign a receipt for the letter confirming that he had received it himself, and even record a video of the entire ordeal as well.More about the case against Thomas Markle Sr.Earlier this week the outlet had reported that Meghan Markle’s father is under public scrutiny and is being investigated on the allegations of possessing materials related to child sexual abuse. The discovery of such content was reportedly made by his son, Thomas Markle Jr., the Duchess of Sussex’s half-brother.These contents were found at his home in Cebu, Philippines, separated in four large boxes that contained “hundreds, if not thousands” of child sexual abuse images, as reported by the outlet. The incident occurred earlier this year on July 10, after which Thomas Jr. “reported his discovery to the FBI Hotline, the US-based National Centre for Exploited and Missing Children, and the state police in Pennsylvania, where his father was living.”He also gave a statement to the outlet about the ongoing matter, revealing, "What I saw made me sick to the stomach—all this stuff was just dumped on me, and I didn’t know what to do. I knew right away it was highly illegal and would land me in jail for a long time if I didn’t get rid of it. I felt betrayed, angry, and disgusted—and realized I had to report him.”On the other hand, PEOPLE reported that Markle was “deeply distressed” over the matter and that her heart was with the children who have suffered because of all of this. She also revealed to the outlet that in 2018, a letter had been shared with the Metropolitan Police and Royalty and Specialist Protection about many allegations against her father, and that when she found out about the letter, she was reassured that the matter is under investigation.Her statement further continued, “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them.”Markle had been aware of the letter since after her wedding to Prince Harry. At the time, she was advised against publicly speaking about the matter. While her father is under investigation over the matter, the MPS is also conducting an internal investigation to track and find out what happened with the letter and why it was not pursued more seriously.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. The couple also revealed their son’s name along with the announcement video.Mawra Hocane explains the meaning of her son’s nameThe actress also shared the meaning behind her son’s name, Syed Azmar Hussain Kamal Gilani. articles.title: Daler Mehndi row: Minister Subodh Uniyal refuses to back down; says, 'Look, we didn’t even start it,' despite efforts to calm tensions
articles.summary: The dispute between Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi and Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal at the Kunjapuri Devi Mela in Tehri is far from over.
articles.body: The dispute between Punjabi singer Daler Mehndi and Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal at the Kunjapuri Devi Mela in Tehri is far from over. The minister is still refusing to back down, even after attempts to cool things down.How the row beganThe clash took place on Monday during Daler Mehndi’s live show. Subodh Uniyal publicly questioned the singer’s behaviour on stage and alleged that he was lip-syncing and was drunk.Minister stands his groundAccording to the India Today report, at a press conference, Subodh Uniyal responded to the demands for an apology. He said, “Look, we didn’t even start it. Tell me, if he hadn’t been a big artist, would he have been let off the hook? If he wasn’t a big artist, why would there be an offer of 36 lakh? Would his mistakes be corrected?”Remarks on the singer’s healthSpeaking about claims that Daler Mehndi was unwell during the show, Subodh Uniyal said artists must inform organisers about their condition in advance. He stated, “He was a big artist, but even now, I believe that — look, a big artist — as I said, if someone’s health is bad, there are two things. They could have declined, or they could have told the public from the stage, ‘I could have been told that my health is not okay; my condition is not good.’ Because this is not written on anyone’s face whose health is bad. It was not told to us either.”Asked whether he would apologise, Subodh Uniyal replied, “Look, fine,” and walked out of the event.Industry reacts, CM intervenesThe incident led to quick criticism from the music world. Daler Mehndi’s brother, singer Mika Singh, strongly defended him and demanded an apology from the minister.Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami then stepped in and spoke to the Mehndi brothers personally to ease the situation. At a press conference, Mika said Dhami had apologised to him on behalf of MLA Subodh Uniyal.Daler Mehndi stays quietThrough all this, Daler Mehndi has not made any personal comment or issued a statement on the matter.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Indira Dhar’s first post-wedding Durga Puja in Kolkata
articles.summary: For filmmaker Indira Dhar, this year’s Durga Puja was different from the ones she has spent in Kolkata over the years.
articles.body: For filmmaker Indira Dhar, this year’s Durga Puja was different from the ones she has spent in Kolkata over the years. Usually travelling abroad for work during October, she consciously decided to stay in the city this time, celebrating the festival with her husband, filmmaker Sayan, their son Kabir and their extended family.“It was a very conscious decision that we would be staying in Calcutta throughout Durga Puja. This year was very special because it was my first year post-marriage,” she says.The celebrations took on a traditional turn at the over 400-year-old Durga Puja of the Rajendra Mullick family in Barabazar, which dates back to 1614. Indira’s mother-in-law’s aunt, Shamuli Mullick, heads the family’s puja. The family deity is believed to have belonged to Raja Man Singh I of Amer before being brought to Kolkata and gifted to Raja Rajendra Mullick. For Indira, being part of the family’s celebrations for the first time was a memorable experience.“I had my parents, our son Kabir, my in-laws and the extended family together. It was a fantastic feeling, and I can’t explain what I felt this year,” she says.Bijoya Dashami was equally special for the family. The celebrations continued at Lake Avenue, where the Durga Puja is held at Kalidhan Institution, associated with Sayan’s great-grandfather. Sayan is now a trustee of the institution along with his father. The family took part in the worship of the deity and the traditional boron rituals.For Indira, however, the festival is also closely tied to her professional life. She says she has marked the beginning of her films with a script puja during Durga Puja for the past three years. This year was no different, as she and Sayan embarked on another project.“I worship Maa Durga every day, especially during Shashthi, and I also attend the Anjali on Ashtami morning. These are two things that the three of us, Sayan, Kabir and I, have done together,” she says.Currently working on an international film, Indira spends much of her time abroad. She credits Sayan’s understanding for helping her balance work and family life, particularly as she takes on a major project following her Bollywood debut. She also acknowledges the close bond Sayan shares with Kabir, which helps make the distance easier to manage.Recalling how her family included her in the festivities even when she was away, she says they connected over Zoom while she was abroad, allowing her to join in virtually.“Sayan and Kabir have a fantastic bonding. They take me on Zoom calls, and even this year, they called me while I was abroad so I could wish everyone. I was happy that I could connect with people,” she says.For Indira, the understanding between partners is essential to making a relationship work, particularly when both have demanding careers. “If you have a good partner, life is easy,” she says, adding that she believes Maa Durga’s blessings have played an important role in bringing them together.As the filmmaker returns to work on her next project, this year’s Puja remains memorable for more than just the rituals. It was an opportunity to embrace family traditions, celebrate with loved ones and begin another creative collaboration with Sayan.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Motivational quote of the day by Robert Downey Jr.: ‘The principle of moving forward eventually gives you confidence,’ a powerful life lesson on building self-belief through action
articles.summary: Robert Downey Jr. is one of the most well-known actors in Hollywood.
articles.body: Robert Downey Jr. is one of the most well-known actors in Hollywood. He is known for playing the role of Tony Stark (aka Iron Man) in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Due to his career being so successful, it is easy to see why what he has to say about confidence is significant. This quote was taken from an article titled ‘The Passion of Robert Downey Jr.’, which was published in Esquire in 2007.Today's Motivational Quote of the Day, “The principle of moving forward eventually gives you confidence.”Meaning behind the quote by Robert Downey Jr.It means that we do not always need to be confident to take our first step. Sometimes we have to take steps forwards even if we are doubting ourselves, then learn from our experiences and trust in ourselves.Downey is suggesting that confidence builds up over time. Looking back on your challenges and what you have achieved will make you start to trust in your abilities. This shows that sometimes we can become too focused on being fully confident to take on new opportunities.Why it is relevant now?Nowadays many people face pressure to be successful quickly. Comparing yourself to others within your career, social media and fear of failure can put people off taking risks or starting something new.Downey reminds us that we do not need to be fully confident to take steps forwards. Whether you are starting a new job, learning something new or trying to rebuild your life after facing a setback, taking your first steps will slowly build up your confidence.The quote also reminds us that we should look back on our experiences to realise how much we have grown. Whilst we may not realise how much we are progressing during a tough time, reflecting can help us see how far we have come.Early life of Robert Downey Jr.Robert John Downey Jr. was born on the 4th April 1965 in Manhattan, New York City. His father was a filmmaker named Robert Downey Sr. and his mother was an actress named Elsie Ann Ford. Growing up in a creative family meant Robert was exposed to the entertainment industry at a young age.He had his first acting role as a child in his father’s film Pound (1970), however he became more serious about his acting career and left school at the age of 16. Having been exposed to film making at a young age helped him develop a passion for acting and he moved to Hollywood.Rise to fame of Robert Downey Jr.During the 1980s Robert Downey started to gain recognition. Films such as Weird Science (1985) and Less Than Zero (1987) helped him get noticed. His portrayal of Charlie Chaplin in Chaplin (1992) earned him a nomination for Best Actor at the Academy Awards, proving he was a skilled dramatic actor.Unfortunately his career was paused due to personal issues. He struggled with substance use and legal issues. After years of struggles he slowly made a comeback with films such as The Singing Detective (2003) and Kiss Kiss Bang Bang (2005).His biggest breakthrough was in 2008 when he played Tony Stark in Iron Man. The film was a huge success and helped create the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Robert became a worldwide star and played the role in multiple films such as The Avengers (2012) and Avengers: Endgame (2019).In 2024 he won Best Supporting Actor at the Academy Awards for his role as Lewis Strauss in Oppenheimer.What we can learn from the quoteThis quote reminds us that confidence can be built up as we make decisions and overcome challenges. We do not need to know everything before we start something new.Sometimes the most important thing to do is keep moving forward. As time goes on, you will put in the effort and gain experience meaning the steps you have taken can be the reason you trust in yourself.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Frame eh paarunga ji’; 'Jailer 2' composer Anirudh Ravichander’s special moment with 'Ramayana' composer AR Rahman goes viral
articles.summary: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander caught the attention of music lovers after sharing a picture with Oscar-winning composer AR Rahman.
articles.body: Music composer Anirudh Ravichander caught the attention of music lovers after sharing a picture with Oscar-winning composer AR Rahman. The photo went viral on social media, with fans celebrating the meeting of two popular names in Indian music. Anirudh posted the picture on his social media page with a playful caption that quickly caught fans' attention. The post also led to discussions about a possible musical collaboration between the two composers.Anirudh’s ‘Frame eh paarunga ji’ caption goes viralSharing the picture, Anirudh wrote, “Frame eh paarunga ji Always the best vibes with my goat @arrahman sir.” The opening line refers to a popular dialogue associated with Rajinikanth’s film Jailer 2. The post received an instant response from fans, who were excited to see the two composers together. AR Rahman’s son, AR Ameen, also shared the photograph on his Instagram Stories and added the song ‘Ravana Tandavam’ from the upcoming film Ramayana. The song features music by Rahman and fellow Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer. Anirudh and GV Prakash Kumar have sung the Tamil version of the track.‘Ramayana’ song brings Anirudh and GV Prakash together with AR RahmanThe song ‘Ravana Tandavam’ is part of director Nitesh Tiwari’s ambitious 'Ramayana,' which stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The film has created strong interest among audiences, with its scale, cast, and music drawing attention. Anirudh and GV Prakash’s contribution to the Tamil version of the song added another interesting connection between leading composers from the Tamil film industry and Rahman’s music team. The viral photograph has also brought fresh attention to their musical association.Fans hope for an Anirudh and AR Rahman musical collaborationFans flooded the comments with reactions to the picture, with several expressing their wish to hear the two composers work together. Some even hoped AR Rahman would sing a song composed by Anirudh for Rajinikanth’s upcoming film 'Dharman.'Anirudh recently received praise for his music in Tamil films, including 'DC' and 'Jailer 2.' With fans eager to see what comes next, his latest picture with AR Rahman sparked fresh excitement about a possible collaboration.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Nayanthara gets 60-foot cut-out installed for ‘Mookuthi Amman 2’; Regina Cassandra praises her co-star
articles.summary: The excitement around 'Mookuthi Amman 2' has reached a new level ahead of its theatrical release, with Nayanthara receiving a grand tribute from her fans.
articles.body: The excitement around 'Mookuthi Amman 2' has reached a new level ahead of its theatrical release, with Nayanthara receiving a grand tribute from her fans. The actor will return to the screen as the goddess Amman in the upcoming sequel, directed by Sundar C. With the film scheduled to release on November 6, the makers and fans are gearing up for its arrival. The latest highlight is a massive cut-out of Nayanthara in her divine look, which has also caught the attention of her co-star Regina Cassandra.Regina Cassandra praises Nayanthara’s 60-foot cut-outRegina Cassandra has expressed her admiration for Nayanthara after a 60-foot cut-out of the actor was installed at Vels Theatre in Chembarambakkam, near Chennai. Reacting to the development, Regina shared a note praising her co-star for reaching this milestone. “This day is going down in history. I was told that Nayan is the first ever actress to have a cut out of this magnitude prior to a film release in Tamilnadu.. That’s a 60 feet feat indeed!” she wrote. Regina also admired Nayanthara’s determination and success, adding, “Call it the will to succeed, call it manifestation, call it whatever you may. It’s admirable and I’m in awe.” Her words have added another highlight to the celebrations surrounding the film.About ‘Mookuthi Amman 2’ release date, cast, and crew The sequel is directed by Sundar C, with Khushbu Sundar and Vignesh Shivan also associated with the production. HipHop Tamizha Aadhi has composed the music. Along with Nayanthara and Regina Cassandra, the film features Urvashi, Abhinaya, Yogi Babu, Myna Nandhini, Duniya Vijay and Singampuli in important roles. Nayanthara’s return as Amman is one of the main attractions, while the film’s mix of fantasy, comedy and devotional elements is expected to draw audiences when it arrives in theatres on November 6.‘Mookuthi Amman 2’ teaser faces criticism ahead of releaseWhile the giant cut-out and Regina Cassandra’s praise have drawn attention, the film’s teaser has also faced criticism on social media. Some viewers have questioned the visual effects, saying that certain computer-generated scenes appear artificial. Others have compared Sundar C’s familiar horror-comedy style to his 'Aranmanai' franchise and questioned whether the sequel will offer a different experience. The teaser has sparked more discussion on social media ahead of the film's release.Despite the criticism, Nayanthara's giant cut-out has grabbed attention. The film's box-office performance will show how audiences respond to her return as Amman.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: In 2018, Adam Levine bought Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner's former Los Angeles estate for USD 31.95 million, redesigned the former Gregory Peck property, and sold it for USD 51M in 2022
articles.summary: Adam Levine, the Maroon 5 singer, purchased Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner's former Los Angeles estate for USD 31.95 million in 2018 and later sold it for USD 51 million in 2022, earning a profit of approximately USD 19.05 million after extensive renovations.
articles.body: During their marriage, Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner owned a stunning 3-acre Los Angeles property together; however, after parting ways in 2018 and finalizing their divorce, the pair put the property up for sale on the market. It seems that the space ended up in the hands of another celebrity. Famed Maroon 5 singer Adam Levine snatched the property off the market that same year and paid a whopping USD 31.95 million for it all. However, years later, he was able to earn a hefty profit after reselling the space. Read ahead to know more about all of this.In 2018, Adam Levine bought Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner’s former houseAfter passing through generations of Hollywood royalty, from the legendary actor Gregory Peck to producer Brian Grazer, and then movie stars Ben Affleck and Jennifer Garner, this 3-acre property has seen a lot of glitz and glam over the years. Ultimately in 2018, Maroon 5 frontman Adam Levine with supermodel Behati Prinsloo ended up with the property. According to the Los Angeles Times, Levine bought the property for USD 31.95 million. This cost included the main residence, along with the sprawling 3-acre land surrounding it all.More about the interior of the house that once belonged to Jennifer Garner and Ben AffleckThe interior of the prime LA property included a ranch-style main house original to the late 1930s, which was designed by pioneering midcentury architect Cliff May. Affleck and Garner purchased the property in 2009 from producer Brian Grazer, who had himself bought the compound for USD 17.5 million and undertook major additions, including expanding living spaces and adding custom amenities.When Levine bought the property, he and Prinsloo teamed up with renowned interior designers to completely change the interiors into a warm, minimalist sanctuary. The house was featured in Architectural Digest's "Open Door" series; the design introduced muted plaster walls, natural light, steel-framed windows, mid-century furnishings, and warm wooden flooring.The living residence spans roughly 9,000 square feet of main living space across three structures: the main house, the guest house, and the separate wellness/gym/office pavilion. Along with this, the home also includes a Dolby-sound screening room, game room, marble bar, and walk-in commercial refrigerator; landscaped walking paths; a swimming pool; a full basketball court; a chicken coop; and expansive views stretching from Downtown LA to the Pacific Ocean.Adam Levine resold the property in 2022 for a massive profitAfter renovating the property, the musician sold it off at a massive profit, according to Realtor.com. He originally listed the property on the market for USD 57.5 million before closing the deal at USD 51 million. The sale became one of the highest property transactions in Southern California that year. They netted an overall gross profit of approximately USD 19.05 million (approximately 59.6% appreciation) over a 3.5-year holding period.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ star Sarah Drew met husband leading worship at Christian youth camp
articles.summary: Sarah Drew reveals how meeting husband Pete Lanfer at a Christian youth camp nearly 30 years ago gave her a grounding force against Hollywood's chaos.
articles.body: "Grey's Anatomy" star Sarah Drew found lasting love long before she found Hollywood fame. Drew opened up about meeting her husband while leading worship at a Christian youth camp nearly three decades ago. The actress, who has been married to Peter Lanfer for 24 years, credited their shared faith and strong partnership with helping her navigate the highs and lows of Hollywood. Drew and Lanfer married in 2002 and have two children. "He's been my steady rock really and safe haven – since way before I had any success in this industry," Drew told Fox News Digital while promoting her upcoming movie, "Jimmy." ‘CHARLIE’S ANGELS’ STAR JACLYN SMITH LIVED APART FROM HER HUSBAND FOR 17 YEARS DURING THEIR 35-YEAR LOVE STORY "And we have been real partners in parenting and in being humans in this world together," she added. "And I think anytime one of us is feeling shaky, the other one is always able to provide a safe harbor and some real like rock-solid strength for the other. So, I do think probably he's my greatest grounding force." Drew described the entertainment industry as an unpredictable business that can celebrate an actor one moment and discard that person the next, explaining why she refuses to let Hollywood determine her self-worth. "I think that it's very easy for Hollywood to tell you who you are. And what I mean by that is, they love you one second, they've forgotten you the next. You're gorgeous one second. They're tearing you to pieces the next. You're working all the time one second, all of a sudden, you're not working anymore, and you don't know what's going on. You never know when you're gonna work again. There is no stability anywhere." Drew said the industry's constant uncertainty makes it difficult for actors to find a sense of stability in their careers. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "There is no place to be grounded in Hollywood. It just doesn't exist," she explained. "We are players to the whims of whoever is making the thing at the certain time and whoever's decided who's interesting or not, and I can't do anything about that." "If I were not sure that my identity was firmly rooted first as a child of God, whose total identity is so much bigger than just who I am as an actress, if I wasn't rooted in that truth — and I know that truth to my cellular level and in my bones — I could so easily get caught up in the highs and think I'm God's gift to the Earth and then fall so miserably into I am absolutely worthless based on how Hollywood has decided to value me at any given time," she added. Drew said her faith has helped her maintain a strong sense of identity beyond her career, reminding her that being a child of God, a wife, a mother and a friend matters more than her success as an actress. Drew stars in "Jimmy," a biographical drama scheduled for nationwide theatrical release Nov. 6. The film follows actor James Stewart's military service, his struggles upon returning to Hollywood and his eventual comeback in the 1946 Christmas classic "It's a Wonderful Life," directed by Frank Capra. Drew stars as Hedda Hopper, one of Hollywood's most influential and feared gossip columnists. "18 months before we started shooting, Aaron Burns …reached out to me and told me that he'd gotten the rights and had a script for this movie, ‘Jimmy,’ that he was gonna make about this incredibly important time in Jimmy's life. And I've always been a huge fan of Jimmy Stewart," she said. Drew said Burns told her he wanted her to play Hedda Hopper, but she didn't know much about the gossip columnist. Burns told her about "this formidable and complicated person." Drew said she doesn't "generally get the opportunity to play roles like this, so I said yes before I got off the phone, before I read the script." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS The "Supernatural" star's Christian faith has also influenced her decision to turn down acting opportunities. While Drew isn't opposed to exploring difficult subjects onscreen, she said she has rejected projects that she believed lacked a meaningful message. "I have turned down jobs because I'm like, I don't know what we're supposed to walk away from this feeling," Drew explained. "I don't see any hope. I only see cynicism. Then I'm not interested." Drew said she has always been drawn to stories that offer something meaningful rather than leaving audiences feeling hopeless. "I just don't understand choosing something that is only going to make people feel darker or more devastated or more hopeless, like those kinds of things," she said. "And I think that that does very much stem from my faith and from my sense of the story that sort of bubbles through my life and has all through my upbringing. And through my adult life and as a parent and as a friend and all of these things, is that I want there to be hope associated with everything that I touch or am a part of – something that you can really like look toward as a beacon of goodness in some ways." That philosophy also plays a central role in how Drew evaluates potential projects, a process she said often involves conversations with her husband. Rather than focusing on the prestige or financial rewards of a project, Drew said the couple first considers whether the story is one she wants to tell. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "It almost never is about what I might get paid, how fancy the project is, what network it's going to be on," she explained. "Those things are absolutely secondary to the first question, which is, 'Do you want to tell the story? Is this story that you think is going to resonate with people?'" "I find that the stories that I'm drawn to are the ones that help people feel less alone and where someone can see themselves in a story," Drew said. "They can pick a redemption arc or a restoration arc and feel a little less alone. And they might laugh and cry and think on their way through the story of it, but at the end of it, they're like, 'Me too. I've also been through something like that. I know what that feeling is, and I feel a little less burdened and a little less alone because I have this opportunity to have this cathartic experience in a way that made me feel seen.'" articles.title: Quote of the day by Taylor Swift: ‘It’s what I’ve been living for all my life. Music has always been a part of me,’ a powerful reminder to follow your passion
articles.summary: Taylor Swift’s journey from a young songwriter to becoming one of the biggest music stars in the world shows just how passionate she has always been about
articles.body: Taylor Swift’s journey from a young songwriter to becoming one of the biggest music stars in the world shows just how passionate she has always been about music. During an interview with Good Morning America (GMA) back in 2004, seen in this video on YouTube, Taylor shared her love for music.Today's quote of the day reads: "It’s what I’ve been living for all my life. Music has always been a part of me." What does the quote mean?This quote from Taylor Swift shows how she wasn’t doing music for fame but because it had always been a vital part of her life. Music had always been her passion and shaped her interests, goals and much more. The quote also reminds us to identify what makes us truly happy and find a way to include it. Whether it be art, writing, sport or any other profession, developing a genuine relationship with your passion can help you stay motivated.Why is this quote relevant today?In a world full of materialistic success, the singer's quote reminds us to think about why we want to achieve our goals. This quote reminds us to stay true to the things that made us passionate about our goals.It is a great reminder to young professionals and aspiring artists who may be unsure of their future. Real success rarely comes overnight and can cause you to feel pressured to prove yourself. However, if you have a real passion for something it can help you stay motivated to learn, develop and keep going.Her quote is especially meaningful as she has continued to develop as a songwriter. Showing how her passion has grown over the years.Taylor Swift’s Early LifeTaylor Alison Swift was born on the 13th December 1989 in Reading, Pennsylvania. She grew up in Wyomissing and developed a passion for music from a young age. Influenced by Country musicians and her Grandma, who was once an opera singer, she began performing at local events and talent shows.Her passion for music developed further and she began playing the guitar as a teenager. She began writing songs about her observations and experiences. She worked hard to turn her passion into a profession.At only 11 years old, she went to Nashville, Tennessee to try and get into the Country music scene. She took her demo recordings to record companies. Her determination caused her family to move to the Nashville area when she was around 14 years old so she could take songwriting and recording seriously.Taylor Swift’s Rise To FameTaylor’s hard work began to pay off as she signed a deal with Sony/ATV to write songs. She then went onto sign a recording deal with Big Machine Records. In 2006 when she was only 16 years old, she released her self titled debut album. This album showed her unique storytelling within her songs. The single "Tim McGraw" helped establish her as a rising star in Country music.In 2008 she released her second album "Fearless". This album was a huge success as songs like "Love Story" and "You Belong with Me" attracted a wider audience. Her songwriting and storytelling created a connection with many people of all ages. In 2010 the album won the Grammy award for Album Of The Year, making her the youngest person to win the category.Over the years Taylor has successfully moved from Country music to mainstream Pop and experimented with Indie Folk music. Albums such as "Folklore" and "Evermore" helped her develop her sound whilst keeping her unique songwriting. This helped her create a genuine connection with her fans.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Vertigo' star Kim Novak plans to become compost after death
articles.summary: Kim Novak, 93, reveals she's arranged to have her body composted after death so loved ones can plant trees, calling it "a beautiful expression."
articles.body: Kim Novak's final act comes with a twist even Alfred Hitchcock couldn't have scripted. The "Vertigo" star has arranged to have her body turned into compost after her death so friends and loved ones can use the resulting soil to plant trees. The 93-year-old, who is the subject of "Kim Novak's Vertigo," a documentary about her life and career, first confirmed her plans to People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA). Novak, who lives on a ranch in Oregon, told Fox News Digital she made the arrangements "a few years ago." 'CRIMINAL MINDS' STAR MANDY PATINKIN SHARES UNCONVENTIONAL PLAN FOR AFTER HIS DEATH "The idea is that I get to live after I'm gone through trees," Novak said. "It's an exciting adventure because this is what I want after I pass. I want to keep living. And one thing that I've always been short on is patience. And a tree has to have patience. I will get to continue to express myself and be an observer of life. To me, it's a beautiful thought. It's given me great peace of mind because I'm going to keep growing. So I'm excited about that." "It sounds funny perhaps, but it isn't really," she said. "I can't imagine being turned into ashes or being put under the ground. Both of those concepts are not too attractive to me." Novak isn't afraid of death, even if her plans may strike some as unconventional. The lifelong nature lover said her connection to the environment has given her peace about what comes next. WATCH: ALFRED HITCHCOCKS BLONDES HAD A GREAT DEAL OF SEX, AUTHOR CLAIMS "Some people may not even be aware that's a choice," Novak said. "And I know some people don't like to talk about death, or think they're going to be turned into ashes or be underground. It sounds awful. But you have a choice. You can decide what comes next." "For me, this was a beautiful concept, the idea of becoming one with the soil," Novak continued. "And with compost, of course, everything grows so much better than if you didn't have it. It helps with growth. You become part of the process. It's natural, it's real, it's honest, it's pure. And I even get to choose the kind of flowers that are going to be part of my compost — forget-me-nots." Although human composting is legal in Oregon, Novak has arranged for her remains to be transported to an Earth Funeral facility in Washington state to undergo the process, known as natural organic reduction. "I’m in Oregon, so it's not that big a deal," Novak said. "However, they’re going to have to pack me in ice in order to make it all the way to this place," she said with a laugh. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE Novak acknowledged that additional options may now be available since she made her arrangements years ago. "I'm having all of my compost, once it's done, delivered to friends and family, a bit of it," she said. "I have instructions for all of them to plant a tree or a shrub, but preferably a tree, because I look forward to keeping growing. That's what it's all about for me. I want to keep growing. This is a beautiful expression of life continuing after death." When Novak began planning her final sendoff, she knew she didn't want to be buried or cremated. She began exploring other options. "Here in Oregon, there was one place where I could have had a tree planted over me," she said. "However, it was only one tree. I'd like to be many trees." According to The Associated Press, Novak was the world's top box-office star from 1958 to 1960. The outlet reported that she stepped away from Hollywood in 1966 to pursue a private life devoted to painting. "Leaving Hollywood taught me that how I live my life matters," she said. "When I left, what mattered the most was being out in nature. I’ve always wanted to be close to nature and live a natural life. Painting has allowed me to continue expressing myself while out in nature. And every day of my life, I’m painting. I can’t wait to wake up each day and start working on a new painting. Sometimes, I’ll stick with a painting for months just because I haven’t fully figured out what I want to express. It’s been a wonderful way to live a life of expression." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "Films were wonderful too," she said. "It’s just all the other stuff that went with it that wasn’t very appealing. But playing a character, becoming one with another person, that always gave me joy. When I look back at my life, I remember all the wonderful opportunities I was given to become a different, beautiful character. But even then, I was drawing too. I used to always draw the characters I was playing in my script. Every time I’d find some new feeling about my character, I would draw it and paint it." Novak's film credits include Otto Preminger's "The Man with the Golden Arm," Joshua Logan's "Picnic," "Pal Joey" and "Bell, Book and Candle." Today, she continues to pursue painting away from Hollywood. But Novak believes her story won't end with her death. "I made my decision because I want to do something good for the environment, and others can too," she said. "After we're gone, the Earth is still here, and we need to protect it. Life goes on when we're no longer here. And in some ways, this doesn't make you feel like you're dying. You're continuing to live on becoming part of the environment. It's something beautiful to look forward to, not dread." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "I don't want to be forgotten," she said. "I want to be remembered not just for films, but for what it made me into, what it turned me into. All the ways I transformed in life, I got to express myself in my art. And I'll continue to express myself." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP ’Kim Novak’s Vertigo’ is now available to stream or purchase on digital platforms.

articles.title: El gran error de RTVE: celebran el 80 aniversario de la primera imagen de la Tierra desde el espacio y se confunden de foto
articles.standfirst: Así lo ha señalado el periodista Luis Alfonso Gámez desde su cuenta de X.com
articles.summary: Así lo ha señalado el periodista Luis Alfonso Gámez desde su cuenta de X.com
articles.body: Ochenta años han pasado desde la primera instantánea de la Tierra desde el espacio. Una imágen que es parte de la historia de los viajes espaciales del ser humano y que fue recordada ayer en el Telediario de RTVE. Un gesto para acercar la ciencia a los telespectadores que, pese al buen gesto de la cadena, tuvo un error que muy pocos pudieron apreciar. Aunque no todos conocieran esa fotografía, de manera casi inmediata a su emisión llegó la corrección del periodista Luis Alfonso Gómez. Fue el encargado en redes sociales de señalar lo que para él fue un grave fallo documental cometido por los informativos de la cadena pública: "En el Telediario, habéis presentado esta imagen como la primera foto de la Tierra sacada desde el espacio. Habéis dicho que fue tomada el 24 de octubre de 1946 por una cámara lanzada en una V-2 que despegó de Estados Unidos. No es así". La crítica no solo desmentía la veracidad visual de la pieza, sino que ponía el foco en un baile de archivos para la efeméride. Tal y como detalló el comunicador, la cadena había mezclado por completo las fechas y los hitos de la carrera espacial al ilustrar la noticia con un material gráfico que pertenecía a otra misión radicalmente distinta a la prometida en el guion. Un mensaje que no solo fue una queja por la equivocación, sino que trató de aclarar qué se estaba proyectando realmente en los televisores de millones de espectadores. Así, Gómez zanjó el asunto aportando la referencia exacta de la confusión: "La imagen con que habéis ilustrado la información es una foto de la Luna (en primer plano) y la Tierra (al fondo) sacada el 23 de agosto de 1966 por la sonda estadounidense Lunar Orbiter I", mientras recordaba que "la primera foto de la Tierra, la del 24 de octubre de 1946, es esta". Dejando atrás el error, el Telediario quiso recordar la historia de aquella gesta que se remonta al desierto de Nuevo México, donde una cámara de 35 mm fue acoplada a un misil V-2 capturado tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Al ser disparado hacia el cielo, el cohete cruzó la frontera invisible de la atmósfera y alcanzó unos 105 kilómetros de altitud, capturando por primera vez en la historia la curvatura del planeta y sus formaciones nubosas sobre el negro absoluto del espacio exterior. Aquel rollo de película sobrevivió milagrosamente a una caída estrepitosa tras estrellarse el cohete contra el suelo a velocidad extrema. Al revelar el material en el laboratorio de White Sands, la ciencia descubrió boquiabierta la silueta frágil de nuestro mundo, sentando los cimientos visuales de la era espacial y convirtiendo un modesto fotograma granulado en el espejo eterno de la humanidad.

articles.title: Pablo López no puede evitar reirse al ser preguntado sobre si estará en el 25 aniversario de OT: "¿No era una celebración?"
articles.standfirst: La reacción del cantante llegó en el programa 'Matí' de Catalunya Ràdio
articles.summary: La reacción del cantante llegó en el programa 'Matí' de Catalunya Ràdio
articles.body: El reconocido músico y compositor Pablo López protagonizó uno de los momentos más comentados en el programa 'Matí' de Catalunya Ràdio, cuando presentaba su nuevo disco 'El cuatro', donde con su característico sentido del humor respondió al ser interpelado por el inminente 25 aniversario de Operación Triunfo. Lejos de mantener una postura hermética o esquivar las preguntas sobre su paso por la mítica academia musical, el artista malagueño optó por la ironía y una carcajada que descolocó por completo a los colaboradores del espacio radiofónico catalán. Durante la entrevista, el exconcursante recordó con total naturalidad su particular vinculación con los inicios del concurso de talentos, llegando a bromear abiertamente sobre su fichaje y su fugaz paso por la discográfica. Entre risas contagiosas, el malagueño bromeó asegurando que es "el único segundo de Operación Triunfo" al que le dieron "la carta de libertad antes de ficharme", desatando la complicidad en el estudio de la emisora. La situación alcanzó su punto álgido cuando los entrevistadores le pusieron sobre la mesa la existencia de un posible programa especial y si formaría parte del listado de invitados oficial. "No, no lo sé, no sé si están...", dejaba caer al ser preguntado si conocía que este programa estaba yendo adelante. Una respuesta que entre un tono de risa confirmaba que, efectivamente, no le habían avisado: "Lo mismo no me han invitado, pero oye, si nos han invitado... no pasaría nada". Una ausencia que no se toma mal y que, con ironía, hablaba del formato del que partió su carrera musical y que comparó con el que es una de las cabezas visibles: "Oye, puedo ir de artista invitado en un momento dado, como integrante de La Voz, por ejemplo", le respondía al periodista que le estaba interpelando en busca de una respuesta. Para arrojar un poco de luz y porque estaba visiblemente desorientado, el conductor del espacio dio entrada a unas declaraciones de Rosa López recientes: "¿Por qué tengo que estar siempre por ser ganadora?", decía la primera ganadora del formato. Una situación que hizo que el malagueño no pudiera reprimir su risa y tiró de ironía para lanzar una pregunta al aire que rápidamente se convirtió en viral: "¿No era una celebración?". Una primera reacción al escuchar el corte de audio en directo, tras la que respondió con más sosiego: "Es que no sé qué ha pasado. No sé, es que de verdad, (...) tú creo que más o menos un poquito me conoces, pero no me entero de nada. No sé a qué se refiere, de verdad. Pero bueno, que, joder, nada de lo que ha dicho es mentira, pero vamos, siempre vamos a ir a la celebración", terminaba diciendo sobre si finalmente se diera una invitación.

articles.title: Amid bomb threat email and health concerns, Amitabh Bachchan greets fans outside Jalsa, protective son Abhishek Bachchan joins his father
articles.summary: Amitabh Bachchan stepped out of his Juhu residence, Jalsa, on Sunday to greet a large gathering of fans as security was tightened around the bungalow
articles.body: Amitabh Bachchan stepped out of his Juhu residence, Jalsa, on Sunday to greet a large gathering of fans as security was tightened around the bungalow following a recent bomb threat email allegedly targeting the veteran actor. Continuing his weekly Sunday Darshan tradition, Bachchan waved to his fans and acknowledged their love and affection. His son, actor Abhishek Bachchan, was also present during the interaction.Mumbai Police personnel were deployed near the residence to maintain security, with Abhishek standing behind his father and keeping an eye on the crowd as the actor greeted his admirers.A bomb threat email allegedly targeting Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow was reported to Mumbai Police on Friday. The email was received by a school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area, following which the police launched an investigation. Further details are awaited, and it is yet to be established whether the threat specifically mentioned Bachchan’s Jalsa or Prateeksha bungalow.Meanwhile, the actor recently shared an update on his health, revealing that he needs more rest as he continues to recover. Bachchan regularly communicates with fans through his blog and social media accounts. He had earlier mentioned that doctors had advised him to take a break from his usual online activity.In a post on his Tumblr blog on Friday, the actor reflected on his recovery and the need to give his body adequate rest. “Yet more rest needed .. adjusting .. thinking and wondering .. the human body and its uniqueness,” he wrote.On the professional front, Amitabh Bachchan is currently hosting the quiz-based reality show 'Kaun Banega Crorepati'. He was last seen in the 2024 Tamil film 'Vettaiyan', which featured Rajinikanth in the lead role.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: What is 'Ghajini' actor Asin doing after quitting movies? Her husband Rahul Sharma reveals how she's raising their daughter Arin Rayn Sharma: 'No TV, no phones, she can understand and speak about 12 languages'
articles.summary: Asin Thottumkal was once among the most popular actresses in Indian cinema, having made a mark in Tamil and Telugu films before entering Bollywood
articles.body: Asin Thottumkal was once among the most popular actresses in Indian cinema, having made a mark in Tamil and Telugu films before entering Bollywood opposite Aamir Khan in 'Ghajini' (2008). The film went on to become the first Hindi film to cross the Rs 100 crore mark at the domestic box office. Despite achieving considerable success, Asin stepped away from acting after marrying Rahul Sharma, co-founder of Micromax, in 2016.Rahul opened up about their relationship, crediting Asin for being a constant source of strength and support in his life. He described her as someone who has always encouraged him to pursue his ambitions, regardless of the challenges he faces.“Marrying Asin was the most important thing that worked well for me. She is the rock behind me. If anything happens, whatever it is, she is the one who says, ‘Don’t worry… you just move forward.’ She understands me and my passion. She is a blind believer. If you have such people around you, life becomes very easy,” he said in an interview with MyGov India.Emphasising the importance of having a supportive partner, Rahul added, “Our partner should be the person who lifts us, not one who pulls us from behind,” he pointed out, adding that the same logic applies in friendship as well. “She is that person for me… she lifts me. Her contribution to my life is more than what I can explain.”Rahul also spoke about their daughter, Arin Rayn Sharma, and expressed amazement at her ability to understand and speak multiple languages at such a young age.“We also have a beautiful daughter (Arin Rayn Sharma). She is just seven years old now but can already understand and speak about 12 languages, including Korean, Japanese, Thai, and Chinese. I am finding it difficult to speak even two languages. We are stuck with English and Hindi.”Reflecting on how Asin manages their family while he focuses on his professional commitments, Rahul said, “You are not just fighting a war outside, but you also have to face a similar one within your home, right? She (Asin) is the one who takes care of the latter [in our home]. I have never seen a person like her in my life,” he said.He also revealed that the couple have chosen to keep television and mobile phones away from their daughter, encouraging her to spend her time reading instead. Giving Asin credit for the approach, Rahul said, “We have not given Arin any screens thus far — no TVs or mobile phones. We only have books at home. We probably have more books at home than Arin has at her school. She is in Class 2 right now, but we already have books for Classes 8 and 9 at home. I quip once in a while, saying, ‘Let her appear for the Class 10 board exam as well. What difference does it make?’ It’s all Asin’s contribution to us,” he pointed out, giving full credit to Asin for the person Arin has turned out to be.Born in Keralam, Asin began her career with advertisements before making her acting debut in the Malayalam film 'Narendran Makan Jayakanthan Vaka' in 2001. She later starred opposite Ravi Teja in the Telugu film 'Amma Nanna O Tamila Ammayi' (2003), which proved to be her breakthrough.Asin made her Hindi film debut with 'Ghajini', reprising the role she had played in the original Tamil film of the same name. She subsequently appeared alongside Salman Khan in 'London Dreams' (2009) and 'Ready' (2011), and starred in Akshay Kumar's 'Housefull 2' and 'Khiladi 786', both released in 2012. That year, she also featured opposite Ajay Devgn in 'Bol Bachchan'. Her last film was 'All Is Well' (2015), co-starring Abhishek Bachchan, before she retired from acting following her marriage.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: 'Baywatch' star David Chokachi credits 3 a.m. wake-ups, twice-daily workouts for unbelievable physique at 58
articles.summary: David Chokachi reveals the Andrew Huberman-inspired ice plunge and 3:30 a.m. routine that got him camera-ready for his return to "Baywatch."
articles.body: David Chokachi is in the best shape of his life thanks, in part, to an unconventional routine. Chokachi, 58, wanted to "make a statement" when he returned to the "Baywatch" set nearly 30 years after he first appeared on-screen as beloved lifeguard Cody Madison. After climbing out of a dark place following an arduous recovery process due to Achilles tendon ruptures, Chokachi said that he "found a higher operating system" within, and became hyper-focused on optimizing his brain chemistry to benefit both mental and physical health. 'BAYWATCH' STAR BRANDY LEDFORD SHARES FITNESS SECRETS AT 57, SAYS SHE'S 'NOT READY TO HANG UP MY BIKINI YET' "I'm up at 3.30 in the morning every day and ready to go. My body's like, 'It's time to go,' and everybody thinks I'm insane, but it's my dream window of time, I love it," Chokachi told Fox News Digital. He cited neuroscientist Andrew Huberman's approach to health as an influence on his own routine and noted that former Navy SEAL DJ Shipley also helped shape his mindset. WATCH: 'BAYWATCH' STAR DAVID CHOKACHI CREDITS EARLY-MORNINGS, TWO-A-DAY WORKOUTS FOR PEAK FITNESS Shipley "found this program of stacking micro wins, which are the little things you do, but you do them every day, and you recognize them, like, 'OK, that was a win,'" Chokachi said. SYLVESTER STALLONE REVEALS SURPRISING HEALTH STRUGGLE BEHIND HIS FAMOUSLY RIPPED PHYSIQUE "The easiest win you can do in a day is get up early, like, really early – I mean it doesn't have to be 3:30, but if you're getting up before other people are, and you're being productive, subconsciously you start to — your brain starts going, your body starts going, 'I am a badass,' you know? And it works, I'm telling you," Chokachi said. In the pursuit of personal challenges, Chokachi doubled down with prepping to be on-screen once again playing a role that made him a global superstar. "With 'Baywatch,' I realized, on the original, the more fit I was, the more stories they'd write for me, the more episodes I'd be in ... not that money is everything, but you want your character to take off," he said. "I've always been into fitness because I grew up playing sports my whole life. "So I did the same thing on this, but I like doubled down because I was the original coming into this new cast and I wanted to make a statement and I made a statement." CARMEN ELECTRA SAYS 'BAYWATCH' PUSHED BOUNDARIES WITHOUT CROSSING THE LINE: 'IT WASN'T PORN' Chokachi said he trained twice a day for six months before stepping on set. "And I showed up on set and when it was time to take my shirt off ... we were shooting a rescue and people were just like, 'Oh my God. Dude, what have you ... how old are you?'" he recalled. "They just, they can't believe it." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "I have an ice plunge and a sauna, and that's usually how I start my day," Chokachi said. "That alone burns a lot of ... brown fat, which is the fat we want to get rid of at the fastest rate by being cold, and ice plunge is really good ... it's a positive stressor on your brain." He added, "So I do that routine, and by the time I've already done that, I'm like, I'm off to the races, like, and I just go." According to the National Institutes of Health, brown fat actually helps the body generate heat by burning calories when exposed to cold temperatures, though research has not established cold plunges as an effective weight-loss method. "Baywatch" first aired in 1989 and ran for a decade before its last episode in 1999, followed by two seasons of "Baywatch: Hawaii." The show became the most widely viewed TV series in the world, with an estimated weekly audience of more than 1.1 billion viewers across 142 countries in 1996, according to Guinness World Records. While Chokachi may have felt he was at his physical peak back then, he said he's "way more fit" now than ever before. GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "I have a leaner fitness," he said. "I used to just bang weights and run back then, so I was a little beefier. And now I live like ... I don't go out, I don't party ... I'm not obsessed about diet, but I don't drink or do anything." He added, "I'm not that diligent, but I do do everything in a day that has gotten me to where I'm at now. And the crazy thing is, it not only helped my fitness level, I feel like I'm doing the best work as an actor I've ever done in 30 years of being an actor, which is wild." Chokachi's next personal challenge will be at the 3rd annual Malibu Moves race, where he plans to complete a 5k carrying a 45-pound weighted backpack, an activity known as "rucking." The effort will also serve as a qualifying test for his local community fire brigade. "It's an awesome day," Chokachi said of the local event held at Zuma Beach. "I've never lived in a place where there's such a real presence of community like Malibu, and, the people ... they go out of their way to help each other. I love being of service." PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE Whether working with Wings of Rescue to help transport dogs at risk of euthanasia because of shelter overcrowding or volunteering with the brigade to keep his community safe, Chokachi is grateful to be living well and helping others along the way. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "I want to maximize my time on this planet," he said. "I want to make this planet a better place than it was when I'm gone. I want my daughter to learn from what I'm doing."

articles.title: Serie A official line-ups: Lecce vs. Juventus
articles.summary: Juventus start Nick Woltemade and Randal Kolo Muani together for the first time in Serie A, desperately trying to get back on track away to unpredictable Lec...
articles.body:
Juventus start Nick Woltemade and Randal Kolo Muani together for the first time in Serie A, desperately trying to get back on track away to unpredictable Lecce amid an injury crisis.

It kicks off at the Stadio Via del Mare at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET).

REGGIO NELL'EMILIA, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 13: Luciano Spalletti Head Coach of Juventus looks on prior to the Serie A match between US Sassuolo and Juventus at Mapei Stadium – Citta' del Tricolore on September 13, 2026 in Reggio nell'Emilia, Italy. (Photo by Emmanuele Ciancaglini/Getty Images)

Luciano Spalletti is really feeling the pressure after a series of dismal results, culminating in the 3-0 home defeat to Lazio.

Things didn't go much better in Thursday's Europa League game, as they fumbled a lead and ultimately scraped the 2-2 draw with Stade Rennais.

That saw the first ever start for the new strike pairing of Woltemade and Kolo Muani, and it is repeated here this evening, with Weston McKennie in a free role behind them.

TURIN, ITALY – OCTOBER 22: Randal Kolo Muani of Juventus looks on during the UEFA Europa League 2026/27 League Phase MD3 match between Juventus and Stade Rennais FC at Juventus Stadium on October 22, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images)

The injury crisis keeps getting worse, with only 17 outfield players making the trip to Lecce.

Nico Gonzalez and Zeki Celik are the latest additions to the absentee list with Kenan Yildiz, Francisco Conceicao, Manuel Locatelli, Khephren Thuram, Jeff Ekhator and Kamil Grabara.

Pierre Kalulu is therefore pushed into a more advanced role, while Teun Koopmeiners joins Douglas Luiz in midfield.

Juventus midfielder Douglas Luiz in action away to Cagliari (@juventus)

Lecce are an all or nothing team, so far winning three games and losing four without a single stalemate.

They are fresh off a sensational 3-0 victory away to Udinese, but it came at a cost, losing Lassana Coulibaly to a muscular injury.

Santiago Pierotti, Ivan Ilic and Medon Berisha are already out of action, so Ousmane Drame' steps into midfield rather than Mohamed Kaba.

Willem Geubbels is supported by Konan N'Dri and Amar Fatah once again.

Lecce have not beaten Juventus since a 2-0 result here in February 2011, followed by four 1-1 draws and eight defeats, home and away.

UDINE, ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Kialonda Gaspar of Lecce celebrates scoring his team's first goal with teammate Konan N'Dri during the Serie A match between Udinese Calcio and US Lecce at Stadio Friuli on October 18, 2026 in Udine, Italy. (Photo by Timothy Rogers/Getty Images)

Lecce: Falcone, Danilo Veiga, Tiago Gabriel, Gaspar, Gallo; Dramé, Ngom, Maleh; N'Dri, Geubbels, Fatah

Juventus: Vicario, Gatti, Bremer, Lucumi; Kalulu, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners, Cambiaso; McKennie; Woltemade, Kolo Muani

articles.title: Javier Romero, chef, y el truco para triunfar con las costillas en la Airfryer: "El secreto está en el adobo, potencia el sabor"
articles.standfirst: La guía definitiva para preparar costillas de cerdo crujientes siguiendo los consejos de los expertos
articles.summary: La guía definitiva para preparar costillas de cerdo crujientes siguiendo los consejos de los expertos
articles.body: La cocina casera se ha transformado por completo con la llegada de las freidoras de aire, convirtiéndose en el electrodoméstico estrella para preparar platos rápidos y con menos grasa. Sin embargo, cuando se trata de recetas tradicionales como la carne adobada, cada cocinero tiene su propia técnica para conseguir un punto óptimo. Entre los creadores de contenido gastronómico más seguidos se encuentra Javier Romero, quien explica de forma muy sencilla cómo es el proceso de preparación en su portal culinario. Para empezar a trabajar con el producto, el cocinero detalla el paso inicial antes de introducir los alimentos en el aparato: "Cortamos las costillas y las ponemos en la cesta de la airfryer". Esta sencilla disposición asegura que el calor comience a actuar de manera uniforme sobre todas las piezas de carne desde el primer minuto. El control de los tiempos es el siguiente factor determinante para evitar que la pieza quede seca o cruda. Siguiendo las indicaciones del chef riojano, el cocinado requiere una pausa a mitad del proceso para remover los ingredientes: "Dejamos cocinar a 180º, durante unos 15 minutos. Después, abrimos, removemos, y las ponemos 5 minutos más". Con este movimiento se consigue un tostado homogéneo por toda la superficie. Por último, más allá de la potencia y la tecnología del electrodoméstico, el éxito de la receta recae fundamentalmente en la calidad de los ingredientes y el tratamiento del adobo. Tal y como destaca el propio Javier Romero para redondear el plato: "En cuanto al sabor, el secreto está en el adobo, que potencia el sabor de la carne". Un broche de oro culinario para disfrutar de un resultado casero, jugoso y lleno de matices. Para que las proporciones en la mesa resulten perfectas, el experto gastronómico detalla los ingredientes necesarios para un plato completo de cuatro raciones. La base consiste en 1 kilo de costillas de cerdo, acompañadas por 3 dientes de ajo, una cucharada de pimentón dulce, otra de orégano, un chorrito de aceite de oliva virgen extra, sal al gusto y un toque de agua para ligar el adobo antes de impregnar la carne.
